destination.name: Huai'an
destination.tagline: Grand Canal port and hometown of Zhou Enlai, with the old lanes of Wu Cheng'en's Hexia.
destination.description: Huai'an is a Grand Canal port that once handled grain shipments to the imperial capital. It is the hometown of Zhou Enlai, and keeps his childhood home, his family school and a memorial hall. Hexia Old Town has Ming and Qing lanes and the home of Wu Cheng'en, author of Journey to the West. The sights are spread over several districts, from Huai'an District to Qingjiangpu.
whyVisit: Follow the life of Zhou Enlai
Walk Ming and Qing canal lanes
Learn how the Grand Canal moved grain

goodToKnow.title: One high-speed station
goodToKnow.detail: High-speed trains stop only at Huai'an East, in the eastern suburbs. Huai'an Station and Huai'an South serve regular trains.

goodToKnow.title: Sights are spread out
goodToKnow.detail: Zhou Enlai's residence, Government House and the canal museum are in Huai'an District. The city museum and zoo are in Qingjiangpu, so plan by district.

goodToKnow.title: Many sights are free
goodToKnow.detail: Zhou Enlai's residence, the memorial hall and the city museum are free. Wu Cheng'en's residence costs about ¥40 and the theme park ¥280.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: Mild weather in {months} suits walking the old lanes, before summer turns hot and wet.
